entities.summary: Aarne Armas "Arska" Arvonen was, at age 111 years, 150 days, a Finnish supercentenarian. Arvonen was born at a time when Finland was still an autonomous part of the Russian Empire. Arvonen was the last known living Finnish person to have been born in the 1800s.
